title: Women lead Durga Puja for first time in remote Bengal village steeped in ancient history
description: The village’s caves are believed to date back to prehistoric times, when early humans used stone implements for hunting and self-defence.

title: New long-clawed dinosaur species identified from century-old fossil in museum drawer
description: A long-overlooked Isle of Wight fossil has revealed Europe’s first known megaraptoran dinosaur, a feathered predator with huge claws.

title: 4,700-year-old shipwreck near Kekova island offers insights into ancient seafaring
description: Archaeological discoveries beneath the sea can provide valuable insights regarding ancient trade, technology and daily life. Amphorae recovered from a shipwreck located near Kekova Island off Antalya, Turkey, are offering researchers with hints regarding maritime connections in the eastern Mediterranean decades ago.
